cause: Training/serving skew on f3 caused by a missing transform on the serving path. The training pipeline applies a log1p transform to f3 (train_f3 = ln(serve_f3 + 1)), while the online service serves the raw, untransformed value (serve_f3 = exp(train_f3) - 1). Verified on the platform via a Trino join of train_skew_1 and serve_skew_1 on entity_id over all 200 matched entities: f1, f2, f4, f5 are identical (abs diff = 0), whereas f3 differs (mean abs diff ~7.7, max ~58.3). The relationship train_f3 = log1p(serve_f3) holds for every row to floating-point precision (max residual ~5e-7, attributable to the 6-decimal CSV rounding). Fix: apply the same log1p transform to f3 in the serving/online feature pipeline (or register it as a Hopsworks on-demand/model-dependent transformation function so train and serve share one definition).
